name: singlet_doublets_expected_rate_estimation
title: Expected doublet rate estimation
description: Estimates, for one library, the expected share of cell-containing partitions that hold two or more cells, with the expected doublet count and a homotypic-adjusted lower bound. Declare count_basis (loaded, recovered or post_qc) because the rate scales with the cell count used. It reads scalar cell counts and optional annotation labels, writes only uns/doublet_rate members, and needs no training. Do not use it to call individual barcodes or as a measured rate; it is a prior for doublet thresholds.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

count_basis.description: Which cell count enters the model. Required because loaded and recovered counts give different rates; there is no default.

method.description: exact_multinomial is the occupancy model (default). The linear methods are published comparators.

library.description: Library key under uns/ for multi-library datasets. Null treats the dataset as one library.

cell_counts.description: Cell count overrides; a null field is read from uns/<library>/loaded_cells or recovered_cells.

recovered.description: Barcodes called as cells before quality filtering.

annotation_column.description: obs column of cell-type labels for the homotypic adjustment. Null reports the unadjusted rate only.

exact_multinomial.description: Options used only when method is exact_multinomial.

partitions.description: Partitions D. Null uses 62500 for recovered or post_qc counts; loaded counts require a value.

scdblfinder_linear.description: Options used only when method is scdblfinder_linear.

pegasus_linear.description: Options used only when method is pegasus_linear.

device.description: auto and cpu run on CPU; cuda is accepted and unused because the closed forms need no accelerator.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing uns/doublet_rate members for this library instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/doublet_rate/<library>/expected_fraction. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: expected_fraction, expected_count, homotypic_adjusted_fraction (null without labels), bounds, poisson_fraction, lambda, partitions, denominator_barcodes, method, count_basis.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
